title: chore(ci): empty spec-shape-retirements.json — all five entries name closed objectui cards (#25108)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D3HAzRn9UnnjnvWeBJbjUjJ)_

Fixes #25108
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What

`scripts/ci/spec-shape-retirements.json`: all five entries in `retirements` are deleted, leaving `"retirements": []`. `$comment` is byte-identical, and no other key exists.

- Why: the registry's own `$comment` says each entry is "deleted when that card closes". All five downstream cards are closed `completed`.
- Why it matters: a stale entry still matches. While one stays, a new break in the same objectui file with the same code and message reads `known` instead of red.
- The entries removed name objectstack PRs #23836, #23846, #24442, #24970 and #24778.

One file, +1 / −82. No gate script, workflow or package change. Nothing publishes, so there is no changeset (`skip-changeset`). Precedent: #23822.

## Measurements (against `origin/main` at `fc7b53ffbf`)

- **Downstream cards** (read through the REST API before the edit):

  | entry (objectstack PR) | downstream card | state | closed |
  |:--|:--|:--|:--|
  | #23836 | objectstack-ai/objectui#12654 | closed `completed` | 2026-10-16T15:04Z |
  | #23846 | objectstack-ai/objectui#12711 | closed `completed` | 2026-10-16T17:06Z |
  | #24442 | objectstack-ai/objectui#13022 | closed `completed` | 2026-10-19T13:05Z |
  | #24970 | objectstack-ai/objectui#13308 | closed `completed` | 2026-10-21T10:21Z |
  | #24778 | objectstack-ai/objectui#13309 | closed `completed` | 2026-10-21T10:09Z |

- **`parseRegistry` accepts an empty array:** `scripts/ci/spec-shape-gate.mjs:857`. The shape check at `:865` refuses only a non-object, or a `retirements` that is not an array (`!Array.isArray(doc.retirements)`). Per-entry rules run inside `doc.retirements.forEach`, so zero entries raise zero problems. The self-test pins this case (`:1470`, "an empty registry loads as zero retirements").
- **The edited file, loaded by the real reader:** `parseRegistry(<the edited file>)` returns `retirements.length === 0` and does not throw.
- **Self-test:** `node scripts/ci/spec-shape-gate.mjs --self-test` gives `60/60 passed across 7 batteries`, both before and after the edit.
- **Other readers of the file:** only `scripts/ci/spec-shape-gate.mjs` and `.github/workflows/spec-shape-gate.yml`. The workflow's `paths:` filter (`:116`) names this file, so this PR runs its own `Spec Shape Gate`.

## Gates

Exit codes were captured before any pipe and reconciled with `--ran`: "22 derived, 22 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN (a DERIVED zero — all 22 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3)".

The first sweep ran in a checkout with no `node_modules`. Six commands exited 3 (`PREREQUISITE NOT MET`): `check-ci-filter-parity`, both `check-closing-keyword-parity` commands, `check-comment-mask-corpus`, `check:cli-command-ids` and `check:driver-memory-census`. After `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` (exit 0, no tracked file changed), all 22 were re-run. The table shows that second sweep.

CI runs the rest of the families on this PR.

## Acceptance notes

- Done when (from the card): this PR's own path-filtered `Spec Shape Gate` run concludes `success` with no "matched nothing" list. That run is CI's to report. It cannot be measured locally.
- Not touched: the gate script's header and grammar. Unlike #23822, no comment in `spec-shape-gate.mjs` or `spec-shape-gate.yml` names any of the five entries, so the change is the JSON file alone.
